correctness.rationale: A sum of three cube roots of unity vanishes exactly when the residues are all distinct. For a frequency difference h, the residues after subtracting the first are 0, h·u_i, h·(t_i-u_i); their distinctness is equivalent to h·t_i=0 and h·u_i≠0. Thus B lies in one affine fiber parallel to W-perp and each u_i evaluation must be a bijection to F_3 on B. An evaluation constant on the fiber obstructs B. In rank one, arbitrary representatives of the three first-evaluation values give exactly one unordered B each. In rank two, the first evaluation fixes the labels and there are six possible permutations for the second; the joint fibers have size 3^(d-r-2). The resulting exponents equal r+3(d-r-s), with the factor six only for s=2. Reordering preserves each nonzero quotient class up to sign. The plane counts follow by separating line directions and the four directions of nonzero triangle sums; the triangle-line witness is obstructed because the line direction equals the triangle sum direction. Independent exact-residue enumeration of all 7056 ordered spatial pairs at d=2 found 4320, 2592, 108 and 36 pairs of respective multiplicities 0, 3, 6 and 27, with no pairwise discrepancy. The proof, not this replay, covers all d.
